_comment: Repository-owned file size policy. Rules are checked in order; first match wins.
_usage: Markdown near its target is counted with Claude Opus 5. Provider use and cached evidence are explicit in this tracked policy.
_patterns: No slash matches a basename. Slash-separated patterns match the full relative path by segment.
_limits: Provider-backed prose uses Anthropic counts for target and hard-limit verdicts. Its tiktoken target is a conservative one-way screen only; above it, a matching content-hash provider count is required. Local-only source rules use tiktoken as their authoritative hard limit.

rules._comment: Source rules pin local-tiktoken so source never leaves the machine. Multi-Forge keeps its established local ceilings; prose calibration does not redefine source limits.

_probe: For provider-backed prose, target_tokens.tiktoken is the conservative local screen. A file clearing it locally is accepted without a provider call. Above it, pre-commit requires a current SHA-256-keyed count in .file-token-counts.json; a keyful refresh command obtains that evidence from Claude Opus 5. A fallback tiktoken count never decides the provider target or ceiling.
